skill_name: Outline the factors that led to the rise in popularity of streaming services.
workflow: The rise in popularity of streaming services can be attributed to a few key factors. Firstly, technological advancements allowed streaming services to become more accessible and user-friendly. This, in turn, made streaming services more attractive to consumers. Secondly, streaming services offered a wider variety of content than traditional television, making it a more attractive option.
